mapper.select: SELECT B.ChnlCode, B.BoardNo, B.BoardTitle, B.BoardCntnts, B.EventCode, E.EventName, B.CustId, B.CustName, B.State, B.Remark, B.RegistId, B.RegistName, B.RegistDate, B.ChangeId, B.ChangeName, B.ChangeDate FROM shopion.tStrEventBoard B INNER JOIN shopion.tStrEvent E ON B.ChnlCode = E.ChnlCode AND B.EventCode = E.EventCode WHERE B.ChnlCode = #{pChnlCode} AND B.BoardNo = #{pBoardNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE shopion.tStrEventBoard SET BoardTitle = #{boardTitle}, BoardCntnts = #{boardCntnts}, EventCode = #{eventCode}, CustId = #{custId}, CustName = #{custName}, State = #{state}, Remark = #{remark}, ChangeId = #{changeId}, ChangeName = #{changeName}, ChangeDate = #{changeDate} WHERE ChnlCode = #{chnlCode} AND BoardNo = #{boardNo}
